notes.title: The Catch: Carp & Coarse - Jezioro Bestii Out Now
notes.content:
The beasts are back and they’re ready for a fight. Fan favourite venue, Jezioro Bestii, returns and it’s better than ever with enhanced visuals and new gameplay features. The existing inhabitants of the lake have grown to epic weights to give you a whole new angling experience.

[previewyoutube=Gq4CBl3Xtnw;full][/previewyoutube]

A closely guarded secret for the anglers that know about it, this 18-acre lake sits up in the mountains of Poland providing spectacular scenery along with a pool of monsters that belong on every angler’s wish list.

Containing 17 different species of fish, more than any other location in The Catch, the venue suits every type of boss fish hunter. This time round we’ve added chub, eels and barbel to the already varied line up of species. It’s the predator fishing where this venue really comes into its own, with record breaking zander weighing in at 25lb, pike reaching over 50lb and monster catfish weighing up to 120lb.

There are 25 new boss fish for you to hunt and catch and 6 brand new events to complete along with a new set of mastery challenges - complete them and you’ll be rewarded with an exclusive underwater scene.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1351270/The_Catch_Carp__Coarse__Jezioro_Bestii/

notes.title: The Catch: Carp & Coarse Update Out Now
notes.content:
Our latest update for The Catch is now live! In this update we've made a few improvments and fixes to enhance your experience in-game. 

Here is the full list of fixes that you will find in this update: 
[list]
[*] 60fps option now available
[*] Hook length can now be adjusted in online events when using float or dropshot rig
[*] After completing and scoring an online event the rewards screen shown should not show player level widget
[*] Fixed issue where you could perform a constant or stop and go retrieve using a dropshot rig
[*] The ‘twitch’ prompt has been renamed to ‘finesse control’ on RT control
[*] Fixed issue with arm animations when when reeling in MP
[*] Favourite bait in angler’s log now shows the correct name
[*] Fix for UI indicating that roach and rudd can be caught with soft plastics
[*] Fixed snail model not appearing in tacklebox customization
[*] ‘No item’ has been changed to ‘none’ in character customization when no accessory is equipped
[*] Stats page now uses separate stats for boss and specimen fish and stats update correctly
[*] Fixed XP bar not animating on catch screen
[*] Fixed level showing incorrectly at end of MP session when player had no progress on their profile
[*] Peter Hudd and Claudia Darga added as anglers in events
[*] Angler headshots now shown on end of event leaderboards
[*] Hide button image when using any letter – when using ""Unbind key"" all buttons can be removed correctly. Note this issue was present in all languages and affected buttons typically using letters eg WASD for movement.
[/list]

notes.title: The Catch: Carp & Coarse is out now!
notes.content:
Your Fishing Adventure Starts Here!  

Prepare your rod and get ready to cast off as The Catch: Carp & Coarse is out now. 

[previewyoutube=txbEtz8uJXg;full][/previewyoutube]

The hunt is on and with 35 species of fish to find, you’ll have to use strategy, skill and tactics to catch the 125 different boss fish found across The Catch: Carp & Coarse’s five venues. Among these are 11 legendary ‘monster’ boss fish - the most elusive, hardest fighting fish in the game.     

 Use finesse mode to focus on your float and look for that all important bite. Don’t wait too long, as the advanced water flow may drift your float – or you and your boat - away from that prime spot. Hook that big fish and intensity mode will test your nerve further, your heart beating harder and faster as the fish tries to escape. Do you have what it takes to land a monster?  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1237610/The_Catch_Carp__Coarse/

notes.title: The Flare Path: A2Z
notes.content:
A is for Alphabetised wargame and sim news.

Every four weeks or so I hang up a streamer of industrial strength fly paper in The Flare Path water closet and see what wargame and simulation news items stick to it. Below is this month’s bag – 25 stories, most of which involve virtual vehicles and surrogate slaughter. If you’ve visited a transport museum or heritage railway in the past twelve months, or can put these battles – Tsushima, Thermopylae, Trenton – in chronological order, you probably won’t regret clicking where it says… (more…)

notes.title: Experience fishing in the jungle... the urban jungle of Rotterdam.
notes.content:
Take a trip to the Maritiem District of Rotterdam to find out more about our street fishing venue in The Catch: Carp & Coarse. 

[previewyoutube=D32XCMhpLwg;full][/previewyoutube]

Located off the Nieuwe Maas, take to the streets and target the wandering shoals of bream and carp that inhabit the open water of mid-river. Fish towards the cover of the moored boats or under the bridges to see if you can draw out the predatory perch, pike and catfish. 

Whether you’re fishing with baits at the bottom of the lake or you’ve grabbed your lure set up, this canal has a lot to offer with 12 species for you to target and 25 boss fish to catch with 2 massive Monster Boss Fish.
